subject: Feasibility sync: GreenBank private deployment — resource clarifications & prioritization
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@greenbank.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, Procurement <procurement@greenbank.com>
Date: 2028-07-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private/VPC pilot request — initial requirements attached

Hi Jonas / Redwood team,

Appreciate the quick intro yesterday. Attached is a short requirements packet for a pilot GreenBank wants to run in Q4. High level: private VPC deployment in us-east, model pinning (open model), no external internet egress from runtime, KMS-backed key management, and 3-month token retention for audit. Procurement has a 45-day lead and legal will need a SOW + security evidence (SOC2 + pen test summary).

Can the team confirm feasibility and a high-level run rate and rough timeline for a pilot (we expect ~250 TPS peaks for inference during batch runs)? We also need to know any gating questions for our security/compliance team.

Attachment: greenbank-initial-requirements.pdf

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Head of Cloud Platforms
GreenBank Financial

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-18T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Private/VPC pilot request — initial requirements attached

Folks — forwarding GreenBank's initial ask. Key asks are VPC-only runtime, KMS, retention constraints and a pilot around Q4 with bursty batch peaks (~250 TPS). They explicitly call out no external egress from runtime.

Please reply with: 1) list of gating questions we must ask customer immediately, 2) very high-level resource and timeline estimate for a pilot (SRE/infra effort + infra cost range), 3) any nonstandard security/product tradeoffs (e.g., model pinning restrictions, feature gaps).

I'm happy to join a customer call once we have a short internal summary.

-Jonas
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Fwd: Private/VPC pilot request — initial requirements attached

Thanks for forwarding, Jonas. Quick product-level read and immediate questions we should surface to Samir:

- Confirm "model pinning": do they need pinned model weights on-premises or is a pinned hosted artifact acceptable? That affects distribution and licensing.
- Clarify inference guarantees: 250 TPS peak—are these sustained or microbursts? Sequence length assumptions?
- Data retention: "3-month token retention for audit" — do they expect searchable logs or raw token dumps? Need clarity for storage sizing and retention tooling.
- Function/tool-calling or streaming needed? This changes runtime footprint.

Initial recommendation:
- Feasibility: YES for a VPC-private runtime with KMS, but model pinning to private infra may require additional legal/model-license checks.
- Investigation window: 2 weeks of engineering scoping to produce a pilot SOW and resource estimate.

Attachment: prod-clarity-asks.docx

Naomi Feldman
Head of Product
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, naomi.feldman@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-19T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private/VPC pilot request — initial requirements attached

Adding security perspective. Short answers / asks for the customer:

- KMS/HSM: We can integrate customer KMS but need network connectivity options (VPC peering or proxy to their KMS endpoint). If they require on-prem HSM with airgap, that materially increases timeline.
- Evidence: ask for their SOC2 point of contact and any recent pen test summary. We'll prepare SOC2 mappings and a scoped controls deck.
- No external egress: we need a detailed network diagram from GreenBank showing where logs/metrics may leave the VPC (monitoring/alerting) so we can propose a boxed monitoring solution.
- Encryption in transit: confirm TLS termination expectations and whether they require mutual TLS for internal service-to-service traffic.

I'll compile a security checklist and mark items that are blocking vs informational.

Attachment: security-checklist.xlsx

Kimberly Park
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, naomi.feldman@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private/VPC pilot request — initial requirements attached

Infra estimates based on the inputs so far:

- Pilot infra footprint (ballpark): 4 x A100-class GPUs (can be lower if quantized models are acceptable), 2 control-plane nodes, 1 small monitoring node in the customer VPC or peered monitoring stack.
- Ops staffing: 3-4 engineer-weeks to stand up pilot environment, + 0.5 FTE support during the 8-week pilot window for runbook and incident response.
- Cost range (raw infra): $30k–$60k month depending on instance sizing and storage retention choices.
- Timeline: 3 weeks for scoping + procurement lead time (they said 45 days) + 2–4 weeks for build/config (depends on HSM/airgap complexity). Airgap adds ~3 weeks to build and additional QA cycles.

Risks / asks:
- Need confirmation whether GreenBank will allow a thin telemetry/alerting channel out of their VPC to our ops team or if we must run entirely within their network.
- Need the network diagram and KMS endpoint details to finalize the runbook.

Attachment: infra-cost-estimate.csv

Marcus Lin
Principal Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Samir Patel <samir@greenbank.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, naomi.feldman@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: Procurement <procurement@greenbank.com>
Date: 2028-07-21T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private/VPC pilot request — initial requirements attached

Thanks all — this is helpful and aligns with internal expectations. A few answers and next steps from our side:

- Model pinning: GreenBank would prefer models hosted in our VPC; they are open to hosted artefacts if legal verifies the license. I'll confirm which models are critical by Wednesday.
- TPS: the 250 TPS is peak for batch jobs (5–10 minute bursts) not sustained 24/7. Typical inference sequences are short (~50 tokens).
- Retention: they need indexed, searchable logs for audit (not raw token dumps).
- KMS: we will provide an endpoint for customer-managed KMS; if an HSM is required we'll flag that during legal.
- Network: procurement can provide the network diagram by EOD Thursday and SOC2 contact for evidence.

Procurement timeline: we will aim to complete internal approvals within 30–45 days; DocuSign SOW will be required. Link once legal prepares it.

DocuSign (placeholder): https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ABCDEF123456
Drive (network diagram to follow): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1GbExampleDriveLink
